BiblicalUsage: The word is the Aramaic offering, and it appears twice: once when Nebuchadnezzar falls on his face and commands an offering to be made to Daniel, and once when Artaxerxes sends money for the offerings of the temple in Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the two offerings show the difference: one is offered to a man by mistake, and the other to God by command, and only the second belongs on an altar.
